subject: Tranche probability refresh — renewal slate tidy-up & churn flags
messages:
From: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>, Jamie Lawson <jamie.lawson@nimbusanalytics.com>
Date: Sun, 8 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Tranche probability refresh — renewal slate tidy-up & churn flags

Team / Jamie —

Quick heads-up as finance closes the month: we did a fast pass on Nimbus' renewal slate and found several mid-size tranches with stale probabilities (many still at generic 60/70%). Before the forecast roll tomorrow, can we do a tranche-level probability refresh and flag accounts with two or more usage dips in the last 90 days?

What I need:
- Ben: run the ARR-tranche export and attach the "renewal-tranche-matrix.xlsx" (column: tranche_id, current_prob, suggested_prob, key_risks).
- Naomi: cross-check any finance/billing disputes in the last 12 months and mark them in the sheet.
- Jamie / Elena (Nimbus): confirm any procurement timing shifts or consolidation plans that would materially change probability by >20 pts. If you can drop a short note on the sheet that helps.

Goal: update probabilities by EOD Tuesday PST so the Q4 forecast reflects tranche-level risk. If anything requires escalation to sales leadership or a one-off credit, flag it and include the expected ARR impact.

Thanks — I want the forecast to avoid surprise downward revisions mid-quarter.

— Priyom
Priyom Das
Senior Revenue Operations Analyst, Redwood Inference
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>, Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>
Cc: Jamie Lawson <jamie.lawson@nimbusanalytics.com>
Date: Mon, 9 Nov 2026 10:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Tranche probability refresh — renewal slate tidy-up & churn flags

On Sun, 8 Nov 2026 at 09:12, Priyom Das wrote:
> Team / Jamie —

Priyom — thanks. I pulled the ARR-tranche export and started the matrix. Attached: renewal-tranche-matrix.xlsx (sheet "raw_export"). I added a suggested_prob column where I adjusted probabilities for high-variance accounts (usage down >30% q/q).

Notable items I flagged:
- TR-412: usage normalized after spike; keep prob at 75 but add note re: upcoming procurement freeze.
- TR-389: usage down 48%; suggested_prob -> 35 and flagged for CS outreach.

I'll hand off the file to Naomi for billing dispute cross-check and then ping Nimbus for schedule confirmation.

— Ben
Ben Carter
Account Strategist, Redwood Inference
From: Jamie Lawson <jamie.lawson@nimbusanalytics.com>
To: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 10 Nov 2026 07:21:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Tranche probability refresh — renewal slate tidy-up & churn flags

Hi Priyom and Ben —

Thanks for the heads-up. Quick context from our side: Nimbus is consolidating two analytics pods into a single enterprise contract, which will delay several tranche renewals from Nov to Jan. I added comments in the sheet (column "Nimbus_notes") for TR-412 and TR-431 and uploaded our usage summary (nimbus-usage-report.pdf).

We expect a procurement freeze window in December; that should affect probabilities for tranches with renewal windows between Dec–Feb. Happy to hop on a 20-min touchpoint if that helps accelerate alignment.

— Jamie
Jamie Lawson
Director, Platform Procurement — Nimbus Analytics
From: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>
To: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Jamie Lawson <jamie.lawson@nimbusanalytics.com>
Date: Tue, 10 Nov 2026 16:34:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Tranche probability refresh — renewal slate tidy-up & churn flags

Thanks all — final update from finance side.

I reconciled billing disputes and credits for the last 12 months and marked the following in the attached matrix: TR-389 (credit applied Q2), TR-402 (late invoice, resolved), TR-431 (no disputes). I also added a "finance_adjusted_prob" column where I lowered probabilities by 10 pts for tranches with unresolved billing questions and added a short rationale.

Next steps/restatement:
- Priyom: please import the updated matrix to the forecast workbook (link above) and replace tranche probabilities in the Forecast->Tranches tab.
- Ben / CS: initiate targeted outreach for TR-389 and TR-412 this week; CS should capture if migration to another vendor is being discussed.
- Jamie: thanks for the procurement timeline notes — if Nimbus confirms the freeze window on the sheet, we'll apply a temporal discount to probabilities for Dec–Feb renewals.

I attached the updated renewal-tranche-matrix.xlsx (sheet "finance_review").

— Naomi
Naomi Feldman
Finance Manager, Revenue Operations — Redwood Inference
